name: computer-use
description: Drive the host computer's mouse, keyboard, and screen from the agent via computer-use-mcp — a near-clone of Anthropic's Computer Use API installable with one npx. Single `computer` tool with 11 actions.

interface.shortDescription: Give the agent control of the local computer's mouse, keyboard, and screen.
interface.longDescription: This skill lets your agent physically control your computer — moving the mouse, typing, clicking, and taking screenshots. Use it when your agent needs to interact with a desktop application, fill a form in a program that has no API, or navigate a tool that only has a graphical interface. Think of it as giving your agent a pair of hands for your computer, for those tasks that can only be done visually.
defaultPrompt: Open the calculator app and do a quick calculation for me.
Take a screenshot of what's currently on my screen.
Fill out this form in the application I have open.
